headline: The airfield's EntryPath/ExitPath hangar list is consumed by an air-operations launch-site object the block owns at block+3Ch. A plane holds a reference to the block at unit+BF4h; the launch-site slot +2Ch (006CF420) turns the chosen hangar exit path into the state-5 taxi target, and the plane bot (009CD540, 009B22C0) flips 4 <-> 5 on a steering-authority test, not on a path threshold.

corrections.was: the EntryPath/ExitPath list is a plausible producer for the taxi paths of ground state 5 but the consumer side was not traced; that link is open
corrections.is: the consumer is the air-operations launch-site object at block+3Ch. 006D2780 feeds 006CF520 and 006CF730 (the launch queue); 006D2640 feeds 006CF420 (the state-5 taxi target), which the plane bot reads every step through (plane+BF4h)->+4h->+3Ch->vtable[2Ch]
corrections.evidence: 006CF55C and 006CF73A call 006D2780; 006CF431, 006CF46D and 006CF494 call 006D2640; 009CD5EB MOV ECX,[EAX+3Ch] then CALL EDX with EDX = [[ECX]+2Ch] at 009CD5FF

corrections.was: 006D5220 walks Hangar %d sub-bags for Object, EntryPath and ExitPath into the 0xC-stride vector at +830h
corrections.is: three source branches keyed on *(airfield+0C0h)+4: the property bag (1), a compiled ushort table with stride 6 at src+13Ch counted by src+138h (2), and the Lua reader hangars/entityID/entryPathID/exitPathID (3). All three store path interfaces from 007AC9D0, not the authored entities
corrections.evidence: the three arms of 006D5220; the compiled arm's (id - DAT_00F89A60)*10h + 0Ch + DAT_00F89AA8 record-map lookup with the iVar5 += 6 stride

corrections.was: unit+BF4h is kGroundContactOwner, "the object the plane rests on"
corrections.is: it is a holder one level further out: holder+4h is the owner's air-operations block (owner+72Ch for MAirfield, owner+1188h for MMothership), block+3Ch the launch-site object and block+7Ch the owner unit. The doc's own dereference chain (unit+BF4h)->+4h->+3Ch->vtable[28h](unit) was already right
corrections.evidence: 007B8E96-007B8EB4 dereferences (value)+4h ->+7Ch and ->+3Ch; 006CFA01 passes unit+72Ch to 007C5F60, which reads +3Ch at 007C5F79, +7Ch at 007C5FDB and +80h at 007C6239

corrections.evidence: 007C5F79 MOV ECX,[EDI+3Ch] and 007C6239 MOV ECX,[EAX+80h], with EDI and EAX the block 006CFA01 formed as unit+72Ch

corrections.was: the owner at block+7Ch exists and its byte at +5Dh is clear. That byte is contract: unread

flow_gaps.reality: 006D2640 is a separate routine (BSP_AirField_PickHangarExitPath) that Ghidra never created; 006D25F0's own body is the four-way BSP_CString_CompareInsensitive chain and is complete as decompiled

flow_gaps.reality: 006CF9F0 ends at 006CFA5D, not the 006CFA7D the scan reported, and 006D2780 ends at 006D284E, not 006D2906; both were re-established from the RET in the listing

uncertainties: The 4 <-> 5 switch predicate: the structure at 009CD7E1-009CD802 is exact, but the x87 comparison at 009CD7A4-009CD7D7 that produces BL was not reduced to closed form. src/airfield_taxi.cpp takes the verdict from the caller rather than recomputing it.

The frame of plane+A4h/+A8h/+ACh. 006CF420 and 006CF520 return their point in the airfield's local frame; 006CF730 samples the path in world space and its tail past 006CF8C0 was not read. The subtraction at 009CD62F is only consistent if the plane's triple is parent-relative and the plane is parented to the airfield on the ground; that parenting was not verified.
plane->vtable[38h] is read by both the taxi law (009CD657) and 006CF5B0 as a per-plane scalar. Its body was not opened, so its meaning is a guess and is not named anywhere.
Why the launch queue takes the hangar with the maximum airfield-local Z and the taxi target the hangar with the minimum. Nothing forces them to be the same hangar.
The trigger of 006CF9F0. Its only reference is the vtable at 00CF8A0C, so what inside 006CDC70 invokes slot +14h, and how a hangar is chosen for a launch, were not reached.

The return leg past the approach: the routine that writes state 1 Inside and the sender of plane message sub-kind 1 were not traced. docs/PLANE_GROUND_OPS.md already assigns the slot release to 006C65B0 through 007F1B70.
006D3250's six park slots at airfield+83Ch are reached by nothing read in this packet.
